“You have had your money,” Torres snarled. “When I went away I gave you double the amount to last you twice as long. Not for two weeks yet is there a centavo due you.”

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u027-r0017", "tag": "p", "text": "“I am in debt,” was the old man’s whimper, the while all the flesh of him quivered and trembled from the nerve-ravishment of the drink so palpably recently consumed.", "sha256": "1a27343981ed2e18164ed8446b28a18aa97195b1acfe939842007ba9ff95f929", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[2312]", "source_html": "

“I am in debt,” was the old man’s whimper, the while all the flesh of him quivered and trembled from the nerve-ravishment of the drink so palpably recently consumed.

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u027-r0018", "tag": "p", "text": "“On the pulque slate at Peter and Paul’s,” Torres, with a sneer, diagnosed unerringly.", "sha256": "278c1db6e33abe35882532e0e2d2a41e65ba2ed34324b9cddc6f558109e2c347", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[2313]", "source_html": "

“On the pulque slate at Peter and Paul’s,” Torres, with a sneer, diagnosed unerringly.

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u027-r0019", "tag": "p", "text": "“On the pulque slate at Peter and Paul’s,” was the frank acknowledgment. “And the slate is full. No more pulque can I get credit for. I am wretched and suffer a thousand torments without my pulque.”", "sha256": "032485a130a42fab8ae641f1e74d3fa51357611a4d98ed89a6947a80cd1abea2", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[2314]", "source_html": "

“On the pulque slate at Peter and Paul’s,” was the frank acknowledgment. “And the slate is full. No more pulque can I get credit for. I am wretched and suffer a thousand torments without my pulque.”

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u027-r0020", "tag": "p", "text": "“You are a pig creature without reason!”", "sha256": "dde5c87cdcb06742fe589a9187748c16d45fba0e411c8acf34f453635db6f3cc", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[2315]", "source_html": "

“You are a pig creature without reason!”

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u027-r0021", "tag": "p", "text": "A strange dignity, as of wisdom beyond wisdom, seemed suddenly to animate the old wreck as he straightened up, for the nonce ceased from trembling, and gravely said:", "sha256": "3039c2a7e32ca879401fd3cc4aacaa09c8bccaf2cf5f75440c878981a2f44c5d", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[2316]", "source_html": "

A strange dignity, as of wisdom beyond wisdom, seemed suddenly to animate the old wreck as he straightened up, for the nonce ceased from trembling, and gravely said:

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u027-r0022", "tag": "p", "text": "“I am old. There is no vigor left in the veins or the heart of me. The desires of my youth are gone. Not even may I labor with this broken body of mine, though well I know that labor is an easement and a forgetting. Not even may I labor and forget. Food is a distaste in my mouth and a pain in my belly. Women—they are a pest that it is a vexation to remember ever having desired. Children—I buried my last a dozen years gone. Religion—it frightens me. Death—I sleep with the terror of it. Pulque—ah, dear God! the one tickle and taste of living left to me!", "sha256": "fc61c001063077765e000bceb38b58e199fbf4765fd7f35e908525c7e68b2d6d", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[2317]", "source_html": "

“I am old. There is no vigor left in the veins or the heart of me. The desires of my youth are gone. Not even may I labor with this broken body of mine, though well I know that labor is an easement and a forgetting. Not even may I labor and forget. Food is a distaste in my mouth and a pain in my belly. Women—they are a pest that it is a vexation to remember ever having desired. Children—I buried my last a dozen years gone. Religion—it frightens me. Death—I sleep with the terror of it. Pulque—ah, dear God! the one tickle and taste of living left to me!

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u027-r0023", "tag": "p", "text": "“What if I drink over much? It is because I have much to forget, and have but a little space yet to linger in the sun, ere the Darkness, for my old eyes, blots out the sun forever.”", "sha256": "c2a2dfb25ba554f3a6ff5566467558d3344def8a4bc21482da54530f434b44f2", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[2318]", "source_html": "

“What if I drink over much? It is because I have much 249to forget, and have but a little space yet to linger in the sun, ere the Darkness, for my old eyes, blots out the sun forever.”

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u027-r0024", "tag": "p", "text": "Impervious to the old man’s philosophy, Torres made an impatient threat of movement that he was going.", "sha256": "2219309626536e3a2f2604d1a007ba7b7878b0d0c68522f7268785cc7260a241", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[2319]", "source_html": "

Impervious to the old man’s philosophy, Torres made an impatient threat of movement that he was going.

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u027-r0025", "tag": "p", "text": "“A few pesos, just a handful of pesos,” the old peon pleaded.", "sha256": "57ed9dd61baaa3e3a7680ebbdf3405b5b9561ad221e8d05b3c6d8f5396f25fe5", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[2320]", "source_html": "

“A few pesos, just a handful of pesos,” the old peon pleaded.

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u027-r0026", "tag": "p", "text": "“Not a centavo,” Torres said with finality.", "sha256": "97994d0b84ef5d5a4f7f94aa2e93766839c5809acace0900d3658e3a41cc5b7f", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[2321]", "source_html": "

“Not a centavo,” Torres said with finality.

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u027-r0027", "tag": "p", "text": "“Very well,” said the old man with equal finality.", "sha256": "412f4fc3e6be0b03b4e2c035330ad5a19d0e190bcd0cb2bb389158d02af37a21", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[2322]", "source_html": "

“Very well,” said the old man with equal finality.

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u027-r0028", "tag": "p", "text": "“What do you mean?” Torres rasped with swift suspicion.", "sha256": "6688f28f1025bb4d3874bf779fa524a2487f183d53f5936a9e1b676b27ed66d8", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[2323]", "source_html": "

“What do you mean?” Torres rasped with swift suspicion.

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u027-r0029", "tag": "p", "text": "“Have you forgotten?” was the retort, with such emphasis of significance as to make Yi Poon wonder for what reason Torres gave the peon what seemed a pension or an allowance.", "sha256": "8e5f3ec91e0ee1c68db6a4d110770f309cf6a029cd5968c47013db3b0bc12e3d", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[2324]", "source_html": "

“Have you forgotten?” was the retort, with such emphasis of significance as to make Yi Poon wonder for what reason Torres gave the peon what seemed a pension or an allowance.

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u027-r0030", "tag": "p", "text": "“I pay you, according to agreement, to forget,” said Torres.", "sha256": "9cea1436284155983c947bec59644502247147885f894498e1f00fdd40b5eeab", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[2325]", "source_html": "

“I pay you, according to agreement, to forget,” said Torres.

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u027-r0031", "tag": "p", "text": "“I shall never forget that my old eyes saw you stab the Senor Alfaro Solano in the back,” the peon replied.", "sha256": "ead12f12d1c8ecffe9e7c14c8aed6a52ac4e121e10ea6d66d2bdb4035a291208", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[2326]", "source_html": "

“I shall never forget that my old eyes saw you stab the Senor Alfaro Solano in the back,” the peon replied.
